company_name: Jiangsu VPTek Semiconductor AOI Equipment Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — VPTek specializes in semiconductor wafer and mask AOI tools, which are critical for defect detection in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Jiangsu VPTek Semiconductor AOI Equipment Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of automated optical inspection (AOI) equipment for semiconductor wafers and masks. Their tools are utilized for inspecting defects in wafer manufacturing and IC packaging, as well as for examining photo masks.
capabilities: Wafer AOI for 2D and 3D defect detection
Photo mask AOI for defect examination
Replacement of KLA 351 and Camtek Eagle models
